newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Matahari Tasikmalaya shop damaged in riot.
newsitem.headline: Matahari Tasikmalaya shop damaged in riot.

text.p: One of Indonesia's largest retailers, PT Matahari Putra Prima, said on Friday its only outlet in the western Javanese town of Tasikmalaya was damaged by rioters on Thursday.

"Yes, our outlet in Tasikmalaya has been damaged by the mob. But I can't give you more details at this time as the phone lines to the outlet are still not working properly," public relations officer Sasa Rinasanti told Reuters.

Officials and residents in Tasikmalaya, 200 km southeast of Jakarta, said a rampaging mob set fire to a number of commercial buildings including the Matahari outlet and churches on Thursday after police had allegedly beaten three religious teachers.
